messages:
Priya: Quick sync — need alignment on v2 route changes covering chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, and tool/function calling. Major customers asking for guaranteed backward compatibility windows. Thoughts?
Alex: From runtime: biggest risk is function-calling schema and structured-output shape changes. We can add an opt-in compat header to preserve v1 payloads for a limited time.
Miguel: +1 on header. Effort estimate: 2w to add routing & compat shim, plus perf hit under high QPS (2-5% CPU).
Sara: Product constraints: default experience must be non-breaking for SDK users. Header opt-in ok but we need an SDK helper, migration guide, and a small eval harness for regressions.
Dan: Customer ask (BigCorp): they want 6 months opt-in and a clear fallback to old route if embeddings drop >1% in similarity for their eval set.
Alex: Embedding threshold is doable if customers provide an eval set. We can expose a "compat_threshold" param on rollout jobs, e.g. `{"emb_sim": "0.99"}` for automated checks.
Priya: Proposed launch criteria: 1) server-side header support + opt-in flag, 2) migration guide + SDK helper, 3) canary at 10% traffic for 2 weeks with metric gates, 4) documented rollback and downgrade path.
Miguel: For tool-calls: runtime will return a structured error when schema mismatch occurs and include a suggested shim snippet. That reduces silent failures.
Sara: Also include a "strict" vs "lenient" output mode in docs so integrators can opt into strict parsing early or stay lenient during cutover.
Jenna: Legal note — if we change defaults for hosted users, need to update TOS/processing notices. Private customers require explicit opt-in; schedule a short review.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/compat-shim at 2007900000 — will post status in #eng-releases when done.
Priya: Action items: Alex -> 2w prototype for header+shim; Miguel -> metric hooks + error shim; Sara -> draft migration guide + sample eval sets; Dan -> sync BigCorp timeline and ask for their eval set; Jenna -> TOS check. Meeting Friday 10am to review canary plan.
Alex: ack
Dan: ack, will ping BigCorp today :wave:
Sara: I'll post draft checklist and a short example: `curl -H "x-redwood-compat: v1" /v2/chat -d '{"input":"..."}'`
Priya: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread unless urgent. :thumbsup:
